void.title: Void invoice?
void.description: This will void the invoice and remove it from active collection workflows. This action cannot be undone.

subsanarVerifactu.title: Correct the Veri*Factu record?
subsanarVerifactu.description: This re-reads the current customer and organization details and generates a correction (subsanación) record to send to AEAT. Fix the wrong details first.

verifactu.title: Veri*Factu
verifactu.retryHelp: Sends records that failed validation again. If the error is in the invoice data, correct it and use Subsanar instead.

issues.title: Veri*Factu issues
issues.description: Invoices whose latest Veri*Factu record AEAT rejected or accepted with errors, or that failed validation before sending. Open the invoice to correct it or retry.
